direct_kronos.distribution_kind: independent autoregressive sampled paths; empirical uncalibrated

price_summary.distribution_kind: independent autoregressive CLOSE paths; empirical uncalibrated
price_summary.validity: Only finite positive generated CLOSE prices; OHLC/volume quality reported separately

tp_sl.derivation: TP=q75(path max close), SL=q25(path min close)
tp_sl.barrier_event: predicted CLOSE crossing only; not intrabar touches
tp_sl.calibration: Uncalibrated model sample frequencies, not observed trade probabilities
tp_sl.same_bar_policy: single close cannot cross disjoint barriers

kronos.py.changes: Keep original KronosTokenizer and Kronos definitions only; remove global sys.path mutation and use relative module import. Predictor and sampling helpers omitted.

provenance.checkpoint_load: strict model state_dict after verified pretrained initialization
provenance.checkpoint_training_status: User-supplied checkpoint; training evidence must be inspected separately

price_unit_transform.rule: Last completed context CLOSE becomes100; OHLC and amount scale together; volume unchanged
price_unit_transform.output_units: Original exchange quote units after exact inverse
price_unit_transform.scaler_fit_scope: Completed input context only; no future price or outcome used

caveats: Frozen pretrained training overlap is unknown; this retrospective diagnostic may have pretraining contamination.
Sample quantiles are uncalibrated and noisy at small sample counts; rejected paths condition the distribution.
Amount is upstream OHLC mean times volume, an approximation; no fills or profit are inferred.

first_touch.assumption: Observed-M1 trained head; fixed one-minute historical latency differs from measured live inference latency.

barrier_exit.assumption: Original model probabilities gate entry only; these separate exits have no calibrated probability or finite model holding deadline.

last_final_decision.rationale: Explicit model-only experiment: positive trained numeric signal; no LLM or context veto claimed.
